title: Empirica host-boundary registry
authority: This file is the authoritative host-boundary registry (ADR-0068, ADR-0069): ids, boundary, outcomes per host and per control mode, sources, and the scenario rows with the tests (`covered_by`) or ledger rows (`live_only`, `ledger_rows`) that settle them. doc/design/empirica-host-boundary-registry.md owns the prose; its data parts are generated from this file (`make registry-doc`), and `make contract-check` fails on any drift, on a reference that does not resolve, on a covering test that does not exist, and on a ledger row that does not exist.

outcomes.allow: End the turn: the run converged and the view says so (`Allow(converged=true)` is the only convergence claim).
outcomes.settle: End the turn with the run view and no notice: exactly one audit is pending and its result continues the run.
outcomes.settle-notice: End the turn with the contract notice of the settlement; the run stays active and not converged, and nothing was approved or confirmed by the settlement.
outcomes.pause: End the turn with a contract notice that is not a convergence claim and names the real next step the human can relay to the agent; the run stays active, nobody was asked, nothing was granted. The same on a first and a later turn end.
outcomes.continue: Keep the turn going: the agent is handed the next obligation (the core's real reason; the evidence directive when a human can be asked about the sole blocker; `unattended_continue` on a later turn end of the same chain). A `continue` cell names the notice of a later turn end; the first turn end of the chain gives the core's reason, or the evidence directive where one is named.
outcomes.end-no-progress: End the turn with the `unattended_continue` notice because a host with no loop bound of its own has already continued on this observation basis; the adapter records `no-progress`.

states.title: exactly one async audit is pending
the sole blocker is a human governance wait or an exhausted budget
the sole blocker is an evidence confirmation a human can be asked about

claude.settle: exit 0; the run view (async audit) or `systemMessage` with the notice
claude.continue: exit 2 with the reason on stderr (the real reason, or the `evidence_report` directive), and `unattended_continue` when `stop_hook_active` is true
claude.loop_bound: Claude's `stop_hook_active` plus its own cap of eight consecutive continuations (`host-capped` otherwise). A deliberative pause ends the turn (ADR-0068 owns the `stop_hook_active` rule).

pi.event: `agent_before_settle` only (never `turn_end`, so one notice per settle); Pi 1.0.0 and later
pi.settle: nothing is appended, or a `custom_message` (`display: true`) with the settlement notice
pi.pause: append a `custom_message` entry (`display: true`) holding the notice, with no `continue`
pi.continue: `continue: true`, with the next obligation as the appended message
pi.loop_bound: None from the host. The adapter keeps its own: it requests a continuation only when the run's observation basis changed since the adapter's previous continuation; otherwise it ends with the `unattended_continue` notice and records `no-progress`.

expectations.title: a human-typed command starts a run with the verbatim goal
expectations.outcomes:
- Claude: `started` | `refused` (structural `Block`: empty goal, unknown flag, non-interactive auto without delegation → "Empirica did not start: …", exit 0) | `faulted` (same block, operator-visible code) | `internal-error` (block "internal error"). Start never wedges prompt expansion.
- Pi: `started` | `refused` (notify "/empirica could not start a run: …") (the `/empirica` command's own refusals: empty goal, unknown flag, owner refusal).
- Codex: best-effort `started` or refused; non-delegated auto and deliberative refused.
expectations.sources: ADR-19 (Creation), ADR-33, ADR-60 ("A run requires a nonblank goal … Trusted host activation records invocation provenance"), QREF scenarios `activation_verbatim_goal`, `empty_goal_refusal`, `noninteractive_auto_refusal`; CODE `P/adapters/claude/lifecycle.py:291-324`, `P/adapters/claude/run_start.py`.

expectations.title: invocation provenance and the initial human surface
expectations.outcomes:
- Claude: `interactive` from `CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT` (`cli` true, `sdk-cli` false) then the transcript, else unknown; `human_surface = unobserved` (the MCP client has not yet declared form elicitation); `audit_retrieval = {local, workspace}` (the auditor definition, `WebFetch` never credited).
- Pi: `interactive` true for `ctx.mode` tui/rpc, false for print/json; `human_surface` = `human` iff `ctx.hasUI`, else `unavailable`; never `unobserved`; `audit_retrieval` from the live preflight.
- Codex: no human ingress → `unavailable`; `audit_retrieval = []`.
expectations.sources: ADR-67 "Confirmation requirement" and "Human surfaces"; T4 §1; Q1; F7 (PROG "F7 host-faithful round"); CODE `P/adapters/invocation.py:provenance`, `P/adapters/claude/run_start.py:invocation_provenance`.

expectations.title: the host version is inside the interval and a receipt is from the qualified version or later
expectations.outcomes:
- Claude: interval `>=2.1.278,<2.2.0`; qualified version `2.1.294`; profile id `claude-code`, which never carries a version (ADR-0069). Compatibility is enforced **at receipt capture and verification** (`scripts/empirica_live_receipts.py:require_compatible_version`), not at run start.
- Pi: `>=1.0.0,<2.0.0` (user ruling 2026-10-08; nothing older is supported, ADR-0069); qualified version `1.1.0`; profile id `pi+pi-subagents-foreground-audit-v1` (the policy, never a version, ADR-0069). Enforced at receipt time.
- Both: a receipt is refused unless its host version is inside the interval and at or above the profile's qualified `version` ("a native receipt from <host> >= <qualified version> is required"); raising the qualified version in the profile therefore asks for exactly one new receipt.
- Codex: exact `0.146.0`.
expectations.sources: ADR-52 (decision and its amendments), ADR-0069 (G6 amendment: the receipt floor), `contracts/empirica/v2/host-profiles.json` (`version` and `compatibility` of the claude-code and pi profiles), `scripts/empirica_live_receipts.py` (`require_compatible_version`), PROGRESS "User ruling 2026-10-08". Tests: `scripts/tests/test_empirica_live_receipts.py::test_compatible_harness_patch_versions_pass_and_are_recorded_exactly`, `::test_a_receipt_below_the_qualified_version_is_refused`, `::test_raising_the_qualified_version_in_the_profile_asks_for_exactly_a_new_receipt`, `::test_incompatible_or_misreported_harness_versions_fail`.

expectations.title: the pi-subagents owner is bound and its version is in the supported range, or the run is refused
expectations.outcomes: Pi: `bound` (reviewed: a compat record exists; or not reviewed: admitted by the owner's own parameter schema and live preflight, shown in the run view; only a `subagent` action some reviewed version has and the classifier calls read-only management runs) | `refused` with one of the closed `OwnerRefusalCode`s (`missing-tool`, `multiple-owners`, `owner-unobservable`, `package-not-pi-subagents`, `version-unobservable`, `child-process`, `preflight-unavailable`, `version-unsupported`, `tool-inactive`, `owner-changed`), each mapped to a public `host.subagents_*` reason (`owner-refusal.ts`) | `unsupported-call` (launch form the owner's version removed, control/mutation action, two launch forms). Claude / Codex: not applicable (no external runtime; a recorded one is `unexpected`). The launch preflight is also refused (`tools-not-read-only`, at start and at launch, any version) when its effective allowlist holds a tool outside `audit_child_tools`; the refusal text carries the contract message of `host.subagents_tools_not_read_only` (`residual.accept`).
expectations.sources: ADR-52 amendment; ADR-0069 (G5-R2, capability admission in a range); D1H §4; PROGRESS "S5" and "G5 flexibility round"; `PT/gate.test.ts` owner tests; `scripts/empirica_subagents_matrix.mjs`.

expectations.title: Claude reviewer derivation resolves, or the audit refuses
expectations.outcomes: Claude: `alias-chosen` | `host-decides` (explicit subagent model) | `refused` (main family unobservable, or no distinct alias resolvable → `AuditProtocolError`, spawn denied). Environment of record: Bedrock, main `opus` (Opus 4.8 [1m]) → reviewer `sonnet` (Sonnet 5.5); the Haiku pin is reached only if the Sonnet pin is absent; main Sonnet 5.5 → `opus` (tests `EHB-MODEL-04`, `-05`, `-06`, S5-R4, no product change). Pi: model chosen by host settings order (canonical agent override, subagent default, main), refused if the effective reviewer identity equals the author's. Codex: not declared (no auditor model).
expectations.sources: ADR-60 "Governance and invocation"; `P/adapters/claude/lifecycle.py:252-272`; PROGRESS "S5" S5-R4; QREF claude.md (settings `env` must reach hooks).

expectations.title: nothing but preparation runs before an approved configuration, and route precedes investigation
expectations.outcomes: Claude: `denied` (PreToolUse exit 2 with the core reason: `governance.approval_required`, `route.required`, `investigation.required`, …) | `admitted` (exit 0). Pi: `{block: true, reason}` | admitted. Codex: delegated acceptance only.
expectations.outcomes_by_mode: All four modes: nothing but preparation runs before an approved configuration, and route precedes investigation. What differs is the source of the approval: deliberative and auto-interactive-pre ask a human; auto-interactive-post and auto-delegated approve automatically inside the approved ceilings (auto-delegated: the fixed 8/1/2 envelope).
expectations.sources: ADR-48, ADR-63, ADR-56; QREF `sentinel_blocked_before_approval`, `configuration_pending`; CODE `P/adapters/claude/lifecycle.py:390-416` (`route_main`), `P/adapters/pi/src/index.ts:845-880`.

expectations.title: a configuration dialog ends in approve, reject or no-decision
expectations.outcomes:
- Claude: `approved` | `declined` (MCP `decline` on the review form, which says "Decline = reject · Esc = decide later") | `no-decision` (cancel, timeout, malformed or invalid content, wrong id, stale proposal, no form). **An MCP `decline` on the locked confirmation is `no-decision`** ("Decline/Esc = keep edits pending"); the code is `adapters/governance.py:decision()`, `Dismiss() if confirmation else Reject()`.
- Pi: `approved` | `declined` | `no-decision` (ui `undefined`, timeout, no UI → `governance.approval_unavailable`).
- Codex: not declared (no dialog).
expectations.outcomes_by_mode: deliberative: a dialog before investigation and for every material change (locked confirmation when amended). auto-interactive-pre: one human approval episode before investigation. auto-interactive-post: no further dialog; non-raising changes are accepted automatically and raises are refused. auto-delegated: no dialog; proposals inside the fixed envelope only. `expected_approval_kind` (`host_ui` or `auto`) decides.
expectations.sources: ADR-63 ("Auto mode: one human approval episode", "Receipts"), ADR-60; HEATH AS3; CODE `P/adapters/governance.py:133-160,205-250`, `P/adapters/pi/src/governance-ui.ts:190-215`, `P/adapters/claude/completion.py:_human_approval_wait`; tests `TT/test_governance_hosts.py::test_cancel_timeout_and_wrong_id_never_approve`, `::test_decline_rejects_without_admitting_work`, `::test_dismissals_durable_and_no_fourth_dialog`, `::test_locked_confirmation_decline_keeps_edits_pending_without_feedback_form`.

expectations.title: an investigative tool call is gated while a run is active
expectations.outcomes: Claude: exit 0 | exit 2 with reason. Pi: permit | `{block:true, reason}`. Codex: declared hook, behaviour not read in G1.
expectations.sources: ADR-48; `P/adapters/claude/route.py:INVESTIGATIVE_TOOLS, build_investigation_request`; `CT/test_claude_adapter.py::test_investigation_hook_fails_closed_for_active_run`, `::test_unknown_mcp_research_and_writers_require_admission_but_public_preparation_does_not`, `::test_subagent_cannot_admit_main_author_evidence`; `PT/gate.test.ts` ("gate: an investigative tool records investigation before execution", "… is blocked when route ordering is denied").

expectations.title: Pi `tool_result` is judged by `isError` alone
expectations.outcomes: Pi: `failed` (`isError`) | `completed`. Claude: `PostToolUseFailure` reconciles an admitted-but-unstarted audit (`agent_failure_main`), observational, exit 0.
expectations.sources: PI-T (G1 PROGRESS B4); PROGRESS "S5" S5-R1 (the `error` branch is kept only if some in-range Pi declares it, else removed — none does).

expectations.title: a Stop never claims convergence, and an `Allow(converged=true)` is the only success
expectations.outcomes: Claude: `allow` (exit 0, view) | `inert` (exit 0, silent) | `settle-notice` (exit 0, `human_wait` or `budget_exhausted`) | `settle` (exit 0, view, one async audit) | `pause` (exit 0, `paused_for_human` or `paused_for_evidence`) | `continue` (exit 2: the real reason, `evidence_report`, or `unattended_continue`) | `fault-closed` (exit 2) | `fault-open` (exit 0, only on an explicit core `fail_direction: open`) | **`host-capped`** (Claude ends the turn after eight consecutive blocks, Empirica not consulted; Q2, `report-limitation`, never relied on). Pi: the same outcomes through its own surface (`HX-STOP-04`).
expectations.outcomes_by_mode: The outcome by control mode and run state is the turn-end table (`turn_end`), the same on every host; this expectation owns only that `Allow(converged=true)` is the sole success.
expectations.sources: ADR-32, ADR-51 (async audit settlement), ADR-63 ("The Claude Stop gate keeps its exact-reason check"), ADR-67 ("An interactive auto Stop never settles as an evidence wait"), ADR-68, D1H §3 (Claude binding protocol item 4), CC "Stop"/"Stop decision control", Q2; CODE `P/adapters/claude/completion.py`.

expectations.title: evidence that only a report can show goes through the directive, then the real reason
expectations.outcomes: Claude: `continue` with the `evidence_report` directive (interactive auto) | `pause` with `paused_for_evidence` (deliberative) | `continue` with the real reason (any other blocker). Pi: not applicable (the Pi gate presents in-process at `report_convergence`).
expectations.outcomes_by_mode: Interactive auto, first and later Stop: the directive (the act-on-it action is the report that asks the human). Deliberative, any Stop: `paused_for_evidence`, which tells the human to tell the agent to report, and that they are asked in that call, if this host can show a dialog. Delegated: the route is `unavailable`, so there is no directive.
expectations.sources: F5 (rulings A2-1/A2-2), F7, ADR-67 ("Asking at the end of the pass"), `public-contract.json settlement_notices.evidence_report`; tests `V2/test_a1_boundaries.py::ClaudeStopEvidenceByControlMode::test_D_the_stop_blocks_with_the_directive_in_every_cell_and_the_mediator_shows_only_when_recorded`, `::test_the_directive_names_the_call_that_asks_the_human`, `CT/test_claude_adapter.py::test_an_interactive_auto_stop_never_settles_for_evidence_and_directs_the_author_to_report`, `V2/test_host_faithful.py::HostFailure::test_the_stop_directive_may_send_one_report_and_that_report_leads_to_stop`.

expectations.title: a turn end is decided by the control mode and the run state, the same on every host (the turn-end table)
expectations.outcomes: Claude: `pause` (exit 0, `systemMessage`, `paused_for_human`/`paused_for_evidence`; the same on the first and on a later Stop; ADR-0068 owns the `stop_hook_active` rule) | `continue` (exit 2; `unattended_continue` when `stop_hook_active` is true) | unchanged settlements (see `HX-STOP-01`). If the host resets `stop_hook_active` between continuations, an auto run's post-tool Stop blocks again and the outcome is `host-capped` (`report-limitation`). Pi: `HX-STOP-04`.
expectations.outcomes_by_mode: See the turn-end table (`turn_end`): deliberative pauses on any other active state; every auto mode continues; the settlements apply in every mode.
expectations.sources: CC "Stop input" and "Stop decision control"; Q2; ADR-0019 (G2), ADR-0051, ADR-0063, ADR-0064 interim (`fb1106b`), ADR-0067 A2-1/A2-2, ADR-0068; HEATH AS3 (`pause`); CODE `P/adapters/claude/completion.py:_turn_end_mode`.

expectations.title: Pi ends a turn at `agent_before_settle` by the turn-end table, and bounds its own continuations
expectations.outcomes: Pi (1.0.0 and later): `allow` and `settle` append nothing (a settlement appends its notice) | `pause` (a `custom_message` with `display: true`, no `continue`) | `continue` (`continue: true`, the next obligation appended) | `end-no-progress` (the `unattended_continue` notice, `no-progress` recorded). Only `agent_before_settle` acts; `agent_settled` is a notification and `turn_end` is not used, so a settle carries one notice.
expectations.sources: ADR-32, ADR-68, `dist/core/extensions/types.d.ts:729-779,805` and `docs/extensions.md:66,117` of Pi 1.1.0 (Q3 surface §1), PI-T (`agent_before_settle`).
expectations.outcomes_by_mode: See the turn-end table (`turn_end`). Deliberative pauses; every auto mode continues while the run's observation basis changes between continuations and ends with `no-progress` otherwise.

expectations.title: SubagentStop is observational and never blocks
expectations.outcomes: Claude: `verdict-admitted` | `audit-failed` (no valid verdict, ambiguous fences, unreadable transcript, served model unobservable or mixed, verdict rejected) | `inert` (not the auditor, no pending child). Pi: not applicable (`HB-AUD-RES`).
expectations.sources: D1H §3 items 5–7, ADR-51, `CT/test_activation_lifecycle.py::test_subagent_stop_is_observational_and_never_blocks`, `CT/test_claude_adapter.py::test_subagent_stop_*`.

expectations.title: a report is the only way to ask for convergence, and it returns the core's decision unchanged
expectations.outcomes: Claude and Pi: `Allow(converged=true)` | `Block` (closed reasons) | `Fault` | `settled-notice` (Pi gate only, for `human_wait`, `evidence_wait`, `budget_exhausted`). Codex: public-only, never trusted ingress.
expectations.outcomes_by_mode: Budget recovery: in deliberative mode a raise is proposed for human approval (`budget.raise`); in every auto mode `budget.raise` is excluded (`recovery_exclusions.auto`) and exhaustion needs a fresh run or an honest `intent=stop`. A sole `budget.exhausted` settles the turn in all modes (`budget_exhausted`). `intent=stop` is available in every mode.
expectations.sources: ADR-32, ADR-67, ADR-42, `PT/gate.test.ts` ("direct tool: report_convergence execute rejects on Block with active handle", "gate: report_convergence tool is permitted on Allow"), `V2/test_evidence_hosts.py::test_report_convergence_through_the_public_tool_presents_then_returns_the_refreshed_view`.

expectations.title: a deliberative step that would end the run without converging asks the human first
expectations.outcomes: Claude and Pi: `Block` with `governance.terminal_stop_pending` while the human has not agreed | the transition commits (`stopped_frozen`, `stopped_residual`, `stopped_budget`) once an accepted, digest-bound receipt covers it. Cancel, timeout and decline grant nothing.
expectations.outcomes_by_mode: Deliberative only. `auto-interactive-pre`, `auto-interactive-post` and `auto-delegated` are unchanged: no dialog, the transition commits as before.
expectations.sources: ADR-0063 (amendment 2026-10-08), ADR-0067 (the confirmation batch), ADR-0026 (amendment 2026-10-08), Q3 findings F-Q3-3.

expectations.title: the surface is observed inside each report, and the latest observation counts
expectations.outcomes: Claude: `human` | `unavailable` (no form, delegated, non-interactive) | `unrecorded` (write failed). Pi: `human` (`ctx.hasUI` with select/input) | `unavailable` (print/json) | `unrecorded`. Initial value Claude `unobserved`.
expectations.outcomes_by_mode: The route `human` is possible in deliberative and interactive auto (before and after the first approval); delegated auto, and any non-interactive run, is `unavailable` at once. Control mode itself is not an input of the route.
expectations.sources: ADR-67 ("Human surfaces", "A failed observation fails closed"), T4 rows 1–9, 15, A1-2 (T2), PROG "F7", "F8", "A7"; tests `V2/test_evidence_hosts.py::SurfaceFailsClosedTests::*`, `V2/test_host_faithful.py::ThirdState::*`, `::HostFailure::test_a_surface_that_cannot_be_recorded_ends_in_an_honest_stop_within_two_calls`.

expectations.title: a batch is presented once per derivation, bound to what is shown
expectations.outcomes: Claude and Pi: `presented` | `not-presented` with a closed `prompt_error` (`unavailable`, `unobserved`, `already_presented`, `interaction_limit`, `surface_unrecorded`, `presentation_failed`) | `refused-conflict` (stale key, nothing spent).
expectations.sources: ADR-67 ("A presentation bounds the batch", "One decision per item", "Nothing is asked twice"), T2 A1-1, A1-3, m2; tests `V2/test_a1_boundaries.py::PresentationBindsWhatWasShown::*`, `::TheHumanSeesTheWholeQuote::*`, `::TheResponseAfterAPresentationIsFresh::*`, `V2/test_evidence_scenarios.py::BatchSizeCells::*`.

expectations.title: an evidence dialog ends in confirm, reject, or no-decision
expectations.outcomes: Claude: MCP `accept` (decoded per item) | `decline` | `cancel` | timeout | exception. Pi: select/input return | `undefined` | timeout | exception. Closed result for both: `confirmed` | `rejected` | `no-decision`.
expectations.sources: ADR-67 ("One decision per item", "Human receipt"), HEATH AS3; tests `V2/test_evidence_hosts.py::MediatorTests::test_cancel_timeout_decline_and_malformed_answers_grant_nothing`, `::test_later_grants_nothing_and_the_presentation_stays_spent`, `::test_a_dialog_that_raises_grants_nothing`, `V2/test_evidence_scenarios.py::BatchSizeCells::test_a_decline_or_cancel_that_carries_content_grants_nothing`, `PT/evidence-ui.test.ts`.

expectations.title: an interrupt ends the turn without a gate, and nothing is granted
expectations.outcomes:
- Claude: turn end by interrupt = **no `Stop` event** (CC); an open MCP elicitation returns `cancel` → `no-decision`; a cancelled running tool does not fire `PostToolUseFailure`. The run stays active, not converged. A `/model` cancelled with Esc did not change settings (Q2 note).
  - Pi: `agent_settled.aborted === true` (Pi) is observable and unused; a cancelled dialog returns `undefined` → `no-decision`; an interrupted `subagent` run returns exit 0 with a non-error "Run paused after interrupt (<agent>)…" result (0.76.1 `subagent-executor.js:3896`) and `finalOutput` "Interrupted. Waiting for explicit next action." (`execution.js:1385`) → no verdict, `audit_failure` (`EHB-INT-03`); with a complete fence it is still a failure (`EHB-INT-04`, see `HX-AUDRES-01`).
  - Codex: not declared.
expectations.sources: CC "Stop" and "PostToolUseFailure input" (`is_interrupt`), PI-T changelog (`agent_settled.aborted`), PS 0.76.1 `src/runs/foreground/execution.js:1307-1313,1385`, `subagent-executor.js:3896`, ADR-63 (dismissal, cancellation, timeout), Q2 notes.

expectations.title: compaction never changes what the run knows
expectations.outcomes:
- Claude: `SessionStart` matcher `compact` → `RestoreRun` → bounded run view on stdout, exit 0 always; orphaned pending audits are reconciled first (`reconcile_orphans(…, include_pending=False)`). A restore failure writes one diagnostic line and exits 0. `PreCompact` is not used (it could block compaction, which Empirica does not).
- Pi: `session_before_compact` dispatches `RestoreRun` best-effort and returns a compaction summary carrying the handle; failure is not a gate. `session_compact` and `session_compact_failed` are not handled.
- Codex: `SessionStart` source `compact` re-evaluates.
expectations.sources: QREF `restore_after_compaction`, ADR-33, T1 §1 ("Restore/compaction must preserve …"), `V2/test_evidence_scenarios.py::RestoreCells::test_everything_the_human_gate_depends_on_survives_a_reload_and_a_restore`, `CT/test_activation_lifecycle.py::test_restore_is_silent_and_exit_zero`, `PT/gate.test.ts` ("session_start reconstructs the handle; compaction carries the handle text").

expectations.title: the author identity follows the main model; a switch revokes no approval
expectations.outcomes:
- Claude: `context-refreshed` (from `to_model`) | `failed-observational` (hook exit 0). Reviewer family is derived at audit launch from the **served** main model, not from the settings key (HX-ADM-03).
- Pi: `context-refreshed` | `tool_call` blocked "empirica governance context unavailable" when the refresh fails.
expectations.sources: ADR-60 ("Identity, evidence, and audit"), QREF `current_author_after_model_switch`, `mixed_producers_block`; `CT/test_activation_lifecycle.py::test_post_model_switch_updates_read_only_context_without_revoking_approval`; CODE `P/adapters/claude/lifecycle.py:274-283`, `P/adapters/pi/src/index.ts:506-508,845-851`.

expectations.title: the canonical audit is reserved, bound, foreground (Pi) or background (Claude), and inherits nothing from the author
expectations.outcomes: Claude: `reserved-and-launched` | `denied` (reason). Pi: `reserved-and-launched` | `blocked` (closed code) | `rejected-after-reserve` (`audit_reject`, refunded once). Codex: Stop-owned bounded `codex exec`, identity `unverified`.
expectations.sources: ADR-51, ADR-52 (explicit read-only acceptance exemption), ADR-49, D1H §3–4, PROGRESS "S5" (S5-R3, S5-R2), G1 B2/B3, `P/adapters/pi/src/audit-launch.ts:32-42`, `P/adapters/claude/lifecycle.py:327-388`; tests `CT/test_claude_adapter.py::test_auditor_reservation_replaces_author_prompt_and_defers_lifecycle`, `::test_auditor_preflight_failure_does_not_reserve`, `PT/gate.test.ts` ("subagent: canonical auditor is reserved, bound, attributed, and prompt-injected"), `PT/preflight-seam.test.ts` ("the seam refuses forced-async, non-foreground, and non-inline launch requests").

expectations.title: an audit result is a verdict only if it is complete, un-errored, and identity-bound
expectations.outcomes:
`verdict-admitted` | `failed` (`isError`, a non-terminal child, no fence, ambiguous or conflicting fences, malformed JSON, unreadable session, served model unobservable or mixed, differs from the admitted verdict) | `orphaned` (reload or shutdown before a result) | `unverified-identity` (verdict kept but identity `pi-child-session-unverified`, so the audit cannot make an independent claim).
  - Pi timed-out child (pi-subagents 0.76.1): `isError: true`, `details.results[0].finalOutput` = `…Partial output before timeout:\n<partial text>`; **an `empirica-verdict` fence inside it is never admitted**: the `isError` branch runs `audit_failure` before any verdict is read. Pinned by `EHB-AUDRES-04`.
  - Pi async-forced start: no per-child result row → `resultText` returns `""` → no verdict → `audit_failure`. Pinned by `EHB-AUDLAUNCH-03`.
